text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending the installation of speed humps on Nymark Avenue, between Bellbury Crescent and Glentworth Road. Staff's assessment indicates the criteria as set out in the updated Traffic Calming Policy has been satisfied. Therefore, speed humps should be installed on Nymark Avenue, between Bellbury Crescent and Glentworth Road.

North York Community Council: 1. Authorized the installation of speed humps on Nymark Avenue, between Bellbury Crescent and Glentworth Road. 2. Directed the City Solicitor to prepare a by-law to alter the roadway for the installation of three (3) speed humps on Nymark Avenue, between Bellbury Crescent and Glentworth Road, generally as shown on Attachment 2, Drawings TC-435 dated December 2024, attached to the report (January 31, 2025) entitled "Traffic Calming (Speed Humps) - Nymark Avenue" from the Director, Traffic Management, Transportation Services. 3. Subject to approval of Parts 1 and 2 above, reduced the speed limit from 40 kilometres per hour to 30 kilometres per hour on Nymark Avenue, between Bellbury Crescent and Glentworth Road, in conjunction with the installation of speed humps.
